## Summary

Describe the observable extension change and affected integration outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] `deno task check`
- [ ] `deno task lint`
- [ ] `deno task test`
- [ ] `deno task fmt`
- [ ] `deno task audit`
- [ ] `deno task validate`
- [ ] `deno task build`
- [ ] Manifest, schemas, translations, examples, runtime dependency records, and
      documentation match the behavior.
- [ ] Capabilities, network targets, and secret names are the smallest possible
      set.
- [ ] No private keys, tokens, credentials, customer data, `dist`, `.edge`, or
      `.fmx` artifacts are included.
- [ ] Bundled third-party code is version-locked and all required notices are
      included.
- [ ] Human-readable names use `FLAMOX365` and `Edge Connector` exactly.
